title.zh: 卷一百十一 列傳第四十一: 姦臣下
title.raw: 卷一百十一 列傳第四十一: 姦臣下 Volume 111 Biographies 41: Treacherous Ministers 2

sentences.zh: 蕭餘里也耶律合魯蕭得裏特蕭訛都斡蕭達魯古耶律塔不也蕭圖古辭

translations.literal: Xiao Yulili, Yelü Helu, Xiao Delite, Xiao Eduwo, Xiao Dalugu, Yelü Tabuye, Xiao Tuguci
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yulili, Yelü Helu, Xiao Delite, Xiao Eduwo, Xiao Dalugu, Yelü Tabuye, and Xiao Tuguci

sentences.zh: 蕭餘里也，字訛都碗，國舅阿剌次子。

translations.literal: Xiao Yulili, style name Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yulili, whose style name was Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.

sentences.zh: 便佞滑稽，善女工。

translations.literal: Fawning and buffoonish, skilled in women's crafts.
translations.idiomatic: He was obsequious and facetious, and excelled at needlework and other domestic crafts.

sentences.zh: 重熙間，以外戚進。

translations.literal: During Chongxi, he advanced through maternal kinship.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he rose through his ties as an imperial in-law.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，補祗候郎君，尚鄭國公主，拜駙馬都尉，累遷南面林牙。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he was appointed attendant langjun, married the Princess of Zheng State, invested as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant, and rose through posts to Southern Court linya.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Qingning he entered service as an attendant langjun, married the Princess of Zheng State, was made Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant, and was promoted step by step to Southern Court linya.

sentences.zh: 以父阿剌為蕭革所譖，出餘里也為奉先軍節度使。

translations.literal: Because his father Ala was slandered by Xiao Ge, Yulili was sent out as military commissioner of Fengxian Army.
translations.idiomatic: When his father Ala was slandered by Xiao Ge, Yulili was posted out as military commissioner of the Fengxian Army.

sentences.zh: 十年冬，召為北面林牙。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter, he was summoned as Northern Court linya.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the tenth year he was recalled to serve as Northern Court linya.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，會有告餘里也與族人術哲謀害耶律乙辛，按無狀，出為寧遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: During Xianyong, there was a report that Yulili and his clansman Shuzhe plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; investigation found no substance, and he was sent out as military commissioner of Ningyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianyong someone reported that Yulili and his kinsman Shuzhe had plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; the inquiry found nothing, and he was sent out as military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 自後餘里也揣乙辛意，傾心事之，薦為國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: Thereafter Yulili gauged Yixin's intentions and devoted himself wholeheartedly; he was recommended as State Uncle xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: After that Yulili read Yixin's wishes and threw himself into serving him, and was recommended for the post of State Uncle xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 大康初，封遼西郡王。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Dakang he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liaoxi Commandery.

sentences.zh: 時乙辛擅恣，凡不附己者出之，乃引餘里也為北府宰相，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。

translations.literal: At the time Yixin acted with unchecked power; whoever did not attach to him was sent away. He then brought in Yulili as Chancellor of the Northern Prefecture and concurrently administrator of Khitan mobile-palace deployments.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin was then ruling arbitrarily: anyone who would not side with him was posted away. He brought Yulili in as Chancellor of the Northern Prefecture and concurrently put him in charge of Khitan mobile-palace deployments.

sentences.zh: 及乙辛謀構皇太子，餘里也多助成之，遂知北院樞密事，賜推誠協贊功臣。

translations.literal: When Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Yulili greatly helped bring it about; he then administered Northern Court privy affairs and was granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.
translations.idiomatic: When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.

sentences.zh: 以女侄妻乙辛子綏也，恃勢橫肆，至有無君之語，朝野側目。

translations.literal: He married his niece to Yixin's son Suiye, relied on his power and acted with reckless arrogance, even speaking words that denied the sovereign; court and countryside watched askance.
translations.idiomatic: He gave his niece in marriage to Yixin's son Suiye, and, trusting in his power, behaved with brazen arrogance, even uttering words that showed no regard for the sovereign; the court and the realm looked on in dismay.

sentences.zh: 帝出乙辛知南院大王事，坐與乙辛黨，以天平軍節度使歸第。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Yixin out to administer Southern Court great king affairs; because Yulili was of Yixin's faction, he was made military commissioner of Tianping Army and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor sent Yixin out to administer Southern Court great king affairs, Yulili, as a member of Yixin's faction, was made military commissioner of the Tianping Army and sent home.

sentences.zh: 尋拜西北路招討使。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以母憂去官，卒。

translations.literal: He left office on account of his mother's mourning and died.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned on mourning for his mother and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律合魯，字胡都堇，六院舍利古直之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Helu, style name Hudujin, was a descendant of the Six-Divisions sheriguzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Helu, whose style name was Hudujin, was descended from the Six-Divisions sheriguzhi.

sentences.zh: 柔佞喜茍合。

translations.literal: Soft, fawning, fond of unprincipled compliance.
translations.idiomatic: He was pliant and sycophantic, and eager to curry favor by any means.

sentences.zh: 仕清寧初。

translations.literal: He entered service at the beginning of Qingning.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office at the start of Qingning.

sentences.zh: 時乙辛引用群小，合魯附之，遂見委任，俄擢南面林牙。

translations.literal: When Yixin was promoting petty men, Helu attached himself and won trust; soon he was promoted to Southern Court linya.
translations.idiomatic: As Yixin was promoting petty followers, Helu attached himself to him, won his trust, and was soon raised to Southern Court linya.

sentences.zh: 乙辛譖皇太子，殺忠直，合魯多預其謀。

translations.literal: When Yixin slandered the crown prince and killed the loyal and upright, Helu took part in many of his plots.
translations.idiomatic: When Yixin slandered the crown prince and killed the loyal and upright, Helu took part in many of his schemes.

sentences.zh: 弟吾也亦黨乙辛，時號「二賊」。

translations.literal: His younger brother Wuye also joined Yixin's faction; at the time they were called "the two villains."
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Wuye also sided with Yixin; people at the time called them "the two villains."

sentences.zh: 乙辛薦為北院大王，卒。

translations.literal: Yixin recommended him as Northern Court great king; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin recommended him as Northern Court great king, and he died in that office.

sentences.zh: 吾也亦至南院大王。

translations.literal: Wuye also rose to Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: Wuye likewise rose to Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 蕭得裏特，遙輦窪可汗宮分人。

translations.literal: Xiao Delite was a member of the palace division of Yaolian Khan Wokohan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Delite belonged to the palace division of Yaolian Khan Wokohan.

sentences.zh: 善阿意順色。

translations.literal: Skilled at fawning and matching others' moods.
translations.idiomatic: He was adept at flattery and at reading others' expressions.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，乙辛用事，甚見引用，累遷北面林牙、同知北院宣徽使事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, when Yixin held power, Delite was greatly employed, successively rising to Northern Court linya and associate administrator of Northern Court Xuanhui commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Qingning, when Yixin was in power, Delite was heavily used and rose through Northern Court linya to associate administrator of Northern Court Xuanhui commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 及皇太子廢，遣得裏特監送上京。

translations.literal: When the crown prince was deposed, Delite was dispatched to supervise escort to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince was deposed, Delite was sent to supervise his transfer to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 得裏特促其行，不令下車，起居飲食數加陵侮，至則築圜堵囚之。

translations.literal: Delite hastened the journey, would not let him alight from the cart, repeatedly insulted him in daily needs and meals, and on arrival built a round earthen wall to imprison him.
translations.idiomatic: Delite hurried the journey along, would not let him step down from the cart, and repeatedly humiliated him in his daily needs and meals; on arrival he built a round earthen enclosure and imprisoned him there.

sentences.zh: 大康中，遷西南招討使，歷順義軍節度使，轉國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: In Dakang he was moved to Southwest pacification commissioner, served as Shunyi Army military commissioner, then transferred to State Uncle xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: During Dakang he was transferred to Southwest pacification commissioner, served as military commissioner of the Shunyi Army, and then became State Uncle xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 壽隆五年，坐怨望，以老免死，闔門籍興聖宮，貶西北統軍司，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong, for resentment and complaint, he was spared death on account of age; his whole household was registered to Xingsheng Palace and he was demoted to Northwest Military Control Office; he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shoulong he was charged with resentment and complaint; because of his age he was spared execution, his entire household was registered to Xingsheng Palace, and he was demoted to the Northwest Military Control Office, where he died.

sentences.zh: 二子：得末、訛裏，乾統間以父與乙辛謀，伏誅。

translations.literal: Two sons: Demo and Eoli; during Qiantong, because their father had plotted with Yixin, they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons, Demo and Eoli; during Qiantong, because their father had plotted with Yixin, both were executed.

sentences.zh: 蕭訛都斡，國舅少父房之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Eduwo was a descendant of the State Uncle Shaofu branch.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Eduwo was descended from the State Uncle Shaofu branch.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，補牌印郎君。

translations.literal: During Xianyong he was appointed seal-and-tally langjun.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianyong he was appointed seal-and-tally langjun.

sentences.zh: 大康三年，樞密使乙辛陰懷逆謀，乃令護衛太保耶律查剌誣告耶律撒剌等廢立事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dakang, Privy Commissioner Yixin secretly harbored treasonous designs and had Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Zhala falsely accuse Yelü Sala and others of plotting deposition and installation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dakang, Privy Commissioner Yixin secretly harbored treasonous intent and had Defender of the Guard grand guardian Yelü Zhala falsely accuse Yelü Sala and others of plotting to depose the emperor and install another.

sentences.zh: 詔按無狀，皆補外。

translations.literal: An edict ordered investigation; finding no substance, all were assigned to outer posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered an inquiry; when nothing was found, all were posted to offices outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 頃之，訛都斡希乙辛意，欲實其事，與耶律塔不也等入闕誣首：「耶律撒剌等謀害乙辛，欲立皇太子事，臣亦預謀。

translations.literal: Before long Eduwo guessed Yixin's wish and, wishing to make the charge real, entered the palace with Yelü Tabuye and others to confess falsely: "Yelü Sala and others plotted to kill Yixin and install the crown prince; I too took part in the plot.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Eduwo divined Yixin's intent and, wanting to make the accusation stick, entered the palace with Yelü Tabuye and others to make a false confession: "Yelü Sala and the others plotted to kill Yixin and put the crown prince on the throne; I too was in on the plot.

sentences.zh: 今不自言，恐事泄連坐。」

translations.literal: If I do not speak now, I fear that when the affair leaks out I will be implicated."
translations.idiomatic: If I do not speak up now, I fear that when the matter comes out I will be punished along with the rest."

sentences.zh: 帝果怒，徙皇太子於上京。

translations.literal: The emperor was indeed enraged and moved the crown prince to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was indeed enraged and transferred the crown prince to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 訛都斡尚皇女趙國公主，為駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao State and served as Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Eduwo married the imperial daughter, Princess of Zhao State, and was made Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant.

sentences.zh: 後與乙辛議不合，銜之，復以車服僭擬人主，被誅。

translations.literal: Later he fell out with Yixin over policy and bore a grudge; again, for carriages and regalia that usurped the sovereign's, he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he disagreed with Yixin and nursed a grievance; he was again executed for carriages and regalia that imitated the sovereign's.

sentences.zh: 訛都斡臨刑，語人曰：「前告耶律撒刺事，皆乙辛教我。

translations.literal: At execution Eduwo told others: "The earlier accusation against Yelü Sala—Yixin taught me all of it.
translations.idiomatic: As Eduwo faced execution he told those present: "The earlier charge against Yelü Sala—Yixin taught me every word of it.

sentences.zh: 恐事彰，殺我以滅口耳！」

translations.literal: Fearing the affair would be exposed, he kills me to silence me!"
translations.idiomatic: He is afraid the truth will come out, so he kills me to seal my lips!"

sentences.zh: 耶律塔不也，仲父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Tabuye was a descendant of the Zhongfu branch.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Tabuye was descended from the Zhongfu branch.

sentences.zh: 以善擊鞠幸於上，凡馳騁，鞠不離杖。

translations.literal: Because he excelled at cuju he won the sovereign's favor; whenever he galloped, the ball never left his mallet.
translations.idiomatic: Because he excelled at cuju he won the emperor's favor; whenever he rode at full speed, the ball never left his stick.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，補祗候郎君。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong he was appointed attendant langjun.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Xianyong he was appointed attendant langjun.

sentences.zh: 與耶律乙辛善，故內外畏之。

translations.literal: Friendly with Yelü Yixin, so inside and outside the court feared him.
translations.idiomatic: He was on good terms with Yelü Yixin, and for that reason everyone at court feared him.

sentences.zh: 及太子被譖，按無跡，塔不也附乙辛，欲實其誣，與訛都斡等密奏：「太子謀亂事本實，臣不首，恐事覺連坐。」

translations.literal: When the crown prince was slandered and investigation found no trace, Tabuye attached himself to Yixin to make the slander real; with Eduwo and others he secretly memorialized: "The crown prince's plot of rebellion was real; if I do not confess first, I fear discovery will implicate me."
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince was slandered and the inquiry found nothing, Tabuye sided with Yixin to make the charge stick; with Eduwo and others he secretly memorialized: "The crown prince's plot of rebellion was real; if I do not come forward first, I fear that when it is discovered I will be punished with the rest."

sentences.zh: 帝信之，廢太子。

translations.literal: The emperor believed it and deposed the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed them and deposed the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 改延慶宮副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to deputy commissioner of Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as deputy commissioner of Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 壽隆元年，為行宮都部署。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong, he was made mobile-palace chief deployer.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shoulong he became mobile-palace chief deployer.

sentences.zh: 天祚嗣位，以塔不也黨乙辛，出為特免部節度使。

translations.literal: When Tianzu succeeded, because Tabuye was of Yixin's faction, he was sent out as Tejian tribe military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzu succeeded to the throne, Tabuye, as a partisan of Yixin, was posted out as military commissioner of the Tejian tribe.

sentences.zh: 及樞密使耶律阿思大索乙辛舊黨，塔不也以賂獲免。

translations.literal: When Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi broadly hunted old Yixin partisans, Tabuye escaped through bribery.
translations.idiomatic: When Privy Commissioner Yelü Asi launched a sweeping purge of Yixin's old faction, Tabuye bought his way free.

sentences.zh: 徙敵烈部節度使，復為敦睦宮使。

translations.literal: He was transferred as Dilie tribe military commissioner, then restored as Dunmu Palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Dilie tribe, then restored as commissioner of Dunmu Palace.

sentences.zh: 天慶元年，出為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqing, he was sent out as Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqing he was posted out as Northwest Circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以疾卒。

translations.literal: He died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness.

sentences.zh: 蕭圖古辭，字何寧，楮特部人。

translations.literal: Xiao Tuguci, style name Hening, was of the Zhute tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Tuguci, whose style name was Hening, was a man of the Zhute tribe.

sentences.zh: 仕重熙中，以能稱，累遷左中丞。

translations.literal: He served in Chongxi, was famed for ability, and rose through posts to Left Vice Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He served during Chongxi, won renown for his ability, and was promoted step by step to Left Vice Censor.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，歷北面林牙，改北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he served as Northern Court linya, then changed to associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Qingning he served as Northern Court linya, then became associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辨敏，善伺顏色，應對合上意。

translations.literal: Sharp-witted, skilled at reading expressions; his replies matched the sovereign's mind.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick and perceptive, skilled at reading the emperor's mood, and his replies always suited the sovereign's wishes.

sentences.zh: 皇太后嘗曰：「有大事，非耶律化哥、蕭圖古辭不能決。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager once said: "For great affairs, nothing can be settled without Yelü Huage and Xiao Tuguci."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager once said, "For any great matter, nothing can be decided without Yelü Huage and Xiao Tuguci."

sentences.zh: 眷遇日隆。

translations.literal: His favor day by day grew.
translations.idiomatic: His favor grew greater day by day.

sentences.zh: 知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: He administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was put in charge of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 六年，出知黃龍府。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was sent out to administer Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was sent out to administer Huanglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was invested as Chancellor of the Southern Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was made Chancellor of the Southern Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 頃之，為北院樞密使，詔許便宜從事。

translations.literal: Before long he was made Northern Court privy commissioner; an edict permitted discretionary action.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he became Northern Court privy commissioner, and an edict allowed him to act at his own discretion.

sentences.zh: 為人奸佞有餘，好聚斂，專愎，變更法度。

translations.literal: As a man he was abundantly treacherous and fawning, fond of extortion, wilfully obstinate, and altered laws and institutions.
translations.idiomatic: In character he was surpassingly treacherous and fawning, greedy for gain, wilfully obstinate, and given to changing laws and institutions.

sentences.zh: 為樞密數月，所薦引多為重元黨與，由是免為庶人。

translations.literal: As privy commissioner for several months, most he recommended were Chongyuan's partisans; thereby he was demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: After only a few months as privy commissioner, most of those he recommended proved to be partisans of Chongyuan; for this he was stripped of rank and made a commoner.

sentences.zh: 後沒入興聖宮，卒。

translations.literal: Later he was confiscated to Xingsheng Palace; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Later his property was confiscated to Xingsheng Palace, and he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：舜流共工，孔子誅少正卯，治奸之法嚴矣。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Shun exiled Gong Gong, Confucius executed Shaozheng Mao—the law for governing traitors was stern indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Shun exiled Gong Gong, and Confucius executed Shaozheng Mao—the standards for dealing with traitors were severe indeed.

sentences.zh: 後世不是之察，反以為忠而信任之，不至於流毒宗社而未已。

translations.literal: Later ages lacked such discernment and instead took them for loyal men and trusted them, not stopping until poison spread through altars and state.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages lacked such discernment and instead took traitors for loyal men and trusted them, not stopping until their poison had spread through the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 道宗之於乙辛是也。

translations.literal: Emperor Daozong's treatment of Yixin was exactly this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daozong's treatment of Yixin was exactly such a case.

sentences.zh: 當其留仁先，討重元，若真為國計者；

translations.literal: When he kept Renxian and campaigned against Chongyuan, it seemed as if he truly acted for the state;
translations.idiomatic: When he kept Yelü Renxian at court and campaigned against Chongyuan, it looked as though he truly had the state's interests at heart;

sentences.zh: 不知包藏禍心，待時而發耳。

translations.literal: not knowing he harbored a treacherous heart and waited for the moment to strike.
translations.idiomatic: who could have known that he was hiding a treacherous heart and biding his time to strike.

sentences.zh: 一旦專權，又得孝傑、燕哥、十三為之腹心，故肆惡而無忌憚。

translations.literal: Once he monopolized power and gained Xiaojie, Yange, and Shisan as his inner core, he therefore unleashed evil without restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Once he held power alone and had Zhang Xiaojie, Yelü Yange, and Xiao Shisan as his inner circle, he therefore committed evil without restraint or fear.

sentences.zh: 始誣皇后，又殺太子及其妃，其禍之酷，良可悲哉。

translations.literal: First he slandered the empress, then killed the crown prince and his consort—the cruelty of the disaster is truly lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: First he slandered the empress, then killed the crown prince and his consort—the cruelty of the harm he wrought is truly lamentable.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 君子所親，莫皇后、太子若也。

translations.literal: Among those a gentleman cherishes, none are like the empress and crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Among those whom a gentleman holds dear, none compare with the empress and the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 奸臣殺之而不知，群臣言之而不悟。

translations.literal: Treacherous ministers killed them yet he did not know; the assembled ministers spoke yet he did not awaken.
translations.idiomatic: Treacherous ministers killed them, yet he did not know; the assembled ministers spoke out, yet he did not understand.

sentences.zh: 一時忠讜，廢戮幾盡。

translations.literal: For a time the loyal and outspoken were nearly all destroyed and executed.
translations.idiomatic: For a time the loyal and outspoken were nearly all destroyed or put to death.

sentences.zh: 雖黑山親見官屬之盛，僅削一字王號，至私藏甲兵然後誅之。

translations.literal: Even when at Black Mountain he personally witnessed the splendor of his staff, only a single character was cut from his princely title; not until he secretly hoarded armor and weapons was he executed.
translations.idiomatic: Even when at Black Mountain the emperor personally saw the grandeur of Yixin's retinue, only one character was struck from his princely title; not until he was found secretly hoarding armor and weapons was he put to death.

sentences.zh: 籲！

translations.literal: Ah!
translations.idiomatic: Ah!

sentences.zh: 乙辛之罪，固非一死可謝天下，抑亦道宗不明無斷有以養成之也。

translations.literal: Yixin's crimes truly could not be expiated by death alone; yet also Daozong's dimness and lack of resolution nurtured them.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin's crimes truly could not be answered by death alone; yet it was also Daozong's dimness and want of resolution that had nurtured them.

sentences.zh: 如蕭餘里也輩，忘君黨惡，以饕富貴，雖幸而死諸牖下，其得免於遺臭之辱哉！

translations.literal: Men like Xiao Yulili forgot their lord and sided with evil to gorge on wealth and rank; though fortunate to die in their own houses, how could they escape the shame of a stinking legacy!
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Xiao Yulili forgot their sovereign and sided with evil to gorge themselves on wealth and rank; though fortunate enough to die in their own homes, how could they escape the shame of a name that stinks forever!
